193	        новый полностью заменяет старый.
194	        """
195	        _validate_code(order_id, "order id")
196	        ttl = DEFAULT_RESERVATION_TTL if ttl is None else ttl
197	        _validate_ttl(ttl)
198	        items = _normalize_lines(lines)
199	        for line in items:
200	            _validate_code(line.sku, "SKU code")

202	            _validate_qty(line.qty)
203	
204	        existing = self._reservations.get(order_id)
205	        if existing is not None:

207	            if status in (ReservationStatus.ACTIVE, ReservationStatus.CONFIRMED):
208	                raise DuplicateReservationError(order_id, status.value)
209	
210	        now = self._clock.now()

212	            available = self._available_at(now, warehouse, sku)
213	            if qty > available:

215

218	            order_id=order_id,

238	    def confirm(self, order_id: str) -> Reservation:

240	        reservation = self._require_reservation(order_id)
241	        now = self._clock.now()

243	        if status is ReservationStatus.EXPIRED:

245	        if status is not ReservationStatus.ACTIVE:

257	            self._log.append(
258	                now, "ISSUE", wh=line.warehouse, sku=line.sku, qty=line.qty, ref=order_id
259	            )
260	        self._log.append(now, "RESERVE_CONFIRM", order=order_id)
261	        confirmed = replace(reservation, status=ReservationStatus.CONFIRMED)
262	        self._reservations[order_id] = confirmed
263	        logger.info("confirmed reservation %s", order_id)
264	        return self._view(confirmed)

266	    def cancel(self, order_id: str) -> Reservation:
267	        """Освобождает активный резерв. Повторная отмена и отмена истёкшего — no-op."""
268	        reservation = self._require_reservation(order_id)
269	        now = self._clock.now()
270	        status = effective_status(reservation, now)
271	        if status is ReservationStatus.CONFIRMED:
272	            raise ReservationStateError(order_id, status.value)
273	        if status is ReservationStatus.ACTIVE:
274	            self._log.append(now, "RESERVE_CANCEL", order=order_id)
275	            reservation = replace(reservation, status=ReservationStatus.CANCELLED)
276	            self._reservations[order_id] = reservation
277	            logger.info("cancelled reservation %s", order_id)
278	        return self._view(reservation)

280	    def extend(self, order_id: str, ttl: timedelta) -> Reservation:
281	        """Продлевает активный резерв: новый срок ``now + ttl``, но срок никогда не сокращается."""
282	        _validate_ttl(ttl)
283	        reservation = self._require_reservation(order_id)
284	        now = self._clock.now()
285	        status = effective_status(reservation, now)
286	        if status is ReservationStatus.EXPIRED:
287	            raise ReservationExpiredError(order_id)
288	        if status is not ReservationStatus.ACTIVE:
289	            raise ReservationStateError(order_id, status.value)
290	
291	        new_expires_at = now + ttl
292	        if new_expires_at <= reservation.expires_at:
293	            return self._view(reservation)
294	        reservation = replace(reservation, expires_at=new_expires_at)
295	        self._reservations[order_id] = reservation
296	        self._log.append(
297	            now, "RESERVE_EXTEND", order=order_id, expires=format_timestamp(new_expires_at)
298	        )
299	        logger.info("extended reservation %s", order_id)
300	        return reservation

302	    # --- служебное ----------------------------------------------------------
303	
304	    def _require_sku(self, sku: str) -> None:
305	        if not self._store.has_sku(sku):
306	            raise UnknownSkuError(sku)
307	
308	    def _check_position(self, warehouse: str, sku: str) -> None:
309	        _validate_code(warehouse, "warehouse")
310	        self._require_sku(sku)
311	
312	    def _require_reservation(self, order_id: str) -> Reservation:
313	        _validate_code(order_id, "order id")
314	        reservation = self._reservations.get(order_id)
315	        if reservation is None:
316	            raise ReservationNotFoundError(order_id)
317	        return reservation
318	
319	    def _view(self, reservation: Reservation) -> Reservation:
320	        """Снимок резерва со статусом на текущий момент."""
321	        status = effective_status(reservation, self._clock.now())
322	        return replace(reservation, status=status)
323	
324	    def _reserved_at(self, now: datetime, warehouse: str, sku: str) -> int:
325	        total = 0
326	        for reservation in self._reservations.values():
327	            if effective_status(reservation, now) is not ReservationStatus.ACTIVE:
328	                continue
329	            for line in reservation.lines:
330	                if line.warehouse == warehouse and line.sku == sku:
331	                    total += line.qty
332	        return total
333	
334	    def _available_at(self, now: datetime, warehouse: str, sku: str) -> int:
335	        # инвентаризация может опустить остаток ниже резервов — тогда свободно 0, а не минус
336	        on_hand = self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku)
337	        return max(0, on_hand - self._reserved_at(now, warehouse, sku))
338	
339	
340	def _validate_code(value: object, what: str) -> None:
341	    """Коды складов/SKU/ссылок попадают в журнал, поэтому без пробелов."""
342	    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value or any(ch.isspace() for ch in value) or "=" in value:
343	        raise ValidationError(f"{what} must be a non-empty string without spaces, got {value!r}")
344	
345	
346	def _validate_ref(ref: object) -> None:
347	    if ref is not None:
348	        _validate_code(ref, "ref")
349	
350	
351	def _validate_qty(qty: object) -> None:
352	    if isinstance(qty, bool) or not isinstance(qty, int) or qty <= 0:
353	        raise InvalidQuantityError(qty)
354	
355	
356	def _validate_ttl(ttl: object) -> None:
357	    if not isinstance(ttl, timedelta) or ttl <= timedelta(0):
358	        raise ValidationError(f"ttl must be a positive timedelta, got {ttl!r}")
359	
360	
361	def _normalize_lines(
362	    lines: Iterable[tuple[str, str, int] | ReservationLine],
363	) -> tuple[ReservationLine, ...]:
364	    """Строки резерва в исходном порядке; пустой резерв — ошибка."""
365	    items: list[ReservationLine] = []
366	    for item in lines:
367	        if isinstance(item, ReservationLine):
368	            items.append(item)
369	        elif isinstance(item, tuple) and len(item) == 3:
370	            items.append(ReservationLine(*item))
371	        else:
372	            raise ValidationError(f"reservation line must be (warehouse, sku, qty), got {item!r}")
373	    if not items:
374	        raise ValidationError("reservation must have at least one line")
375	    return tuple(items)
376	
377	
378	def _sum_by_position(lines: Iterable[ReservationLine]) -> dict[tuple[str, str], int]:
379	    """Суммы по позициям (склад, SKU) в порядке первого появления."""
380	    totals: dict[tuple[str, str], int] = {}
381	    for line in lines:
382	        key = (line.warehouse, line.sku)
383	        totals[key] = totals.get(key, 0) + line.qty
384	    return totals

"""Резервы товара под заказы.

Резерв хранит товар под заказ, но физический остаток не меняет. Срок действия
проверяется по часам сервиса в момент обращения: фоновых задач нет, поэтому
истёкший резерв — это активный резерв, у которого ``expires_at`` уже наступил.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timedelta

from .models import Reservation, ReservationStatus

DEFAULT_RESERVATION_TTL: timedelta = timedelta(minutes=15)


def effective_status(reservation: Reservation, now: datetime) -> ReservationStatus:
    """Статус резерва на момент ``now``: активный с наступившим сроком — истёкший."""
    if reservation.status is ReservationStatus.ACTIVE and now >= reservation.expires_at:
        return ReservationStatus.EXPIRED
    return reservation.status

1	"""Журнал складских событий.
2	
3	Каждое событие сериализуется в одну строку::
4	
5	    000003 2026-03-01T10:15:00Z ISSUE qty=2 ref=SO-17 sku=BOLT-M8 wh=MAIN
6	
7	* порядковый номер — 6 цифр, растёт с 1 без пропусков;
8	* время — UTC, формат :data:`TIMESTAMP_FORMAT` (секундная точность, суффикс ``Z``);
9	* тип события — заглавные латинские буквы и ``_``;
10	* поля ``key=value`` в алфавитном порядке ключей, отсутствующее значение — ``-``.
11	
12	Журнал — источник данных для отчётов о движении и для внешней выгрузки,
13	поэтому формат строки менять нельзя.
14	"""
15	
16	from __future__ import annotations
17	
18	import logging
19	import re
20	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
21	from datetime import datetime, timezone
22	from types import MappingProxyType
23	from typing import Iterator, Mapping
24	
25	from .errors import EventFormatError
26	
27	logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
28	
29	TIMESTAMP_FORMAT = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"
30	MISSING = "-"
31	
32	_KIND_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Z][A-Z_]*$")
33	_KEY_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z][a-z_]*$")
34	
35	
36	def format_timestamp(moment: datetime) -> str:
37	    """Момент времени в формате журнала."""
38	    if moment.tzinfo is None:
39	        raise EventFormatError("naive datetime cannot be written to the event log")
40	    return moment.astimezone(timezone.utc).strftime(TIMESTAMP_FORMAT)
41	
42	
43	def parse_timestamp(text: str) -> datetime:
44	    try:
45	        parsed = datetime.strptime(text, TIMESTAMP_FORMAT)
46	    except ValueError as exc:
47	        raise EventFormatError(f"bad timestamp {text!r}") from exc
48	    return parsed.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
49	
50	
51	def _format_value(key: str, value: object) -> str:
52	    if value is None:
53	        return MISSING
54	    if isinstance(value, bool):
55	        raise EventFormatError(f"field {key!r}: booleans are not supported")
56	    if isinstance(value, int):
57	        return str(value)
58	    if isinstance(value, str):
59	        if not value or any(ch.isspace() for ch in value) or "=" in value:
60	            raise EventFormatError(f"field {key!r}: value {value!r} cannot be logged")
61	        return value
62	    raise EventFormatError(f"field {key!r}: unsupported type {type(value).__name__}")
63	
64	
65	@dataclass(frozen=True)
66	class Event:
67	    """Одна запись журнала. Значения полей хранятся уже в строковом виде."""
68	
69	    seq: int
70	    ts: datetime
71	    kind: str
72	    fields: Mapping[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
73	
74	    def format(self) -> str:
75	        parts = [f"{self.seq:06d}", format_timestamp(self.ts), self.kind]
76	        parts.extend(f"{key}={self.fields[key]}" for key in sorted(self.fields))
77	        return " ".join(parts)
78	
79	    def get(self, key: str) -> str | None:
80	        """Значение поля или ``None``, если поле отсутствует или равно ``-``."""
81	        value = self.fields.get(key)
82	        return None if value in (None, MISSING) else value
83	
84	
85	def parse_line(line: str) -> Event:
86	    """Разбор строки журнала обратно в :class:`Event`."""
87	    tokens = line.strip().split(" ")
88	    if len(tokens) < 3:
89	        raise EventFormatError(f"malformed event line {line!r}")
90	    seq_text, ts_text, kind, *pairs = tokens
91	    if not (len(seq_text) == 6 and seq_text.isdigit()):
92	        raise EventFormatError(f"bad sequence number {seq_text!r}")
93	    if not _KIND_RE.match(kind):
94	        raise EventFormatError(f"bad event kind {kind!r}")
95	    fields: dict[str, str] = {}
96	    for pair in pairs:
97	        key, sep, value = pair.partition("=")
98	        if not sep or not _KEY_RE.match(key) or not value:
99	            raise EventFormatError(f"bad field {pair!r}")
100	        fields[key] = value
101	    return Event(int(seq_text), parse_timestamp(ts_text), kind, MappingProxyType(fields))
102	
103	
104	class EventLog:
105	    """Журнал событий в памяти, только на добавление."""
106	
107	    def __init__(self) -> None:
108	        self._events: list[Event] = []
109	
110	    def append(self, ts: datetime, kind: str, **fields: object) -> Event:
111	        if not _KIND_RE.match(kind):
112	            raise EventFormatError(f"bad event kind {kind!r}")
113	        rendered: dict[str, str] = {}
114	        for key, value in fields.items():
115	            if not _KEY_RE.match(key):
116	                raise EventFormatError(f"bad field name {key!r}")
117	            rendered[key] = _format_value(key, value)
118	        # время в журнале — с точностью до секунды
119	        ts = ts.astimezone(timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0)
120	        event = Event(len(self._events) + 1, ts, kind, MappingProxyType(rendered))
121	        self._events.append(event)
122	        logger.debug("event %s", event.format())
123	        return event
124	
125	    def events(self, kind: str | None = None) -> list[Event]:
126	        if kind is None:
127	            return list(self._events)
128	        return [event for event in self._events if event.kind == kind]
129	
130	    def lines(self) -> list[str]:
131	        return [event.format() for event in self._events]
132	
133	    def __iter__(self) -> Iterator[Event]:
134	        return iter(list(self._events))
135	
136	    def __len__(self) -> int:
137	        return len(self._events)

T0 = datetime(2026, 3, 1, 10, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)

    assert res.status is ReservationStatus.ACTIVE
    assert res.created_at == T0
    assert res.expires_at == T0 + timedelta(minutes=15)
    assert inv.on_hand("MAIN", "BOLT-M8") == 10
    assert inv.reserved("MAIN", "BOLT-M8") == 4
    assert inv.available("MAIN", "BOLT-M8") == 6

        ("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 1),

    assert res.lines == (
        ReservationLine("NORTH", "NUT-M8", 2),

"""Сервис складского учёта: приход, расход, перемещение, инвентаризация.

Любая операция, меняющая остатки, пишет событие в журнал
(:class:`~warehouse.events.EventLog`). Операция либо выполняется целиком,
либо не меняет ничего — ни остатков, ни журнала.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from dataclasses import replace
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Iterable

from .clock import Clock, SystemClock
from .errors import (
    DuplicateReservationError,
    DuplicateSkuError,
    InsufficientStockError,
    InvalidQuantityError,
    ReservationExpiredError,
    ReservationNotFoundError,
    ReservationStateError,
    UnknownSkuError,
    ValidationError,
)
from .events import EventLog, format_timestamp
from .models import Availability, Reservation, ReservationLine, ReservationStatus, Sku, StockLevel
from .reservations import DEFAULT_RESERVATION_TTL, MAX_RESERVATION_LIFETIME, effective_status
from .storage import InMemoryStore

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class Inventory:
    """Остатки товаров по складам и резервы под заказы."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        store: InMemoryStore | None = None,
        clock: Clock | None = None,
        log: EventLog | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._store = store if store is not None else InMemoryStore()
        self._clock = clock if clock is not None else SystemClock()
        self._log = log if log is not None else EventLog()
        # хранятся статусы ACTIVE / CONFIRMED / CANCELLED; EXPIRED вычисляется по часам
        self._reservations: dict[str, Reservation] = {}
        # истёкшие резервы, которые заменил новый до того, как о них записали RESERVE_EXPIRE
        self._replaced_expired: list[Reservation] = []
        # о каких истёкших резервах уже записано RESERVE_EXPIRE: (order_id, created_at)
        self._expiry_reported: set[tuple[str, datetime]] = set()

    @property
    def store(self) -> InMemoryStore:
        return self._store

    @property
    def clock(self) -> Clock:
        return self._clock

    @property
    def log(self) -> EventLog:
        return self._log

    # --- справочник ---------------------------------------------------------

    def register_sku(self, code: str, name: str, unit: str = "pcs") -> Sku:
        _validate_code(code, "SKU code")
        if self._store.has_sku(code):
            raise DuplicateSkuError(code)
        sku = Sku(code=code, name=name, unit=unit)
        self._store.add_sku(sku)
        logger.info("registered SKU %s", code)
        return sku

    def get_sku(self, code: str) -> Sku:
        sku = self._store.get_sku(code)
        if sku is None:
            raise UnknownSkuError(code)
        return sku

    # --- запросы ------------------------------------------------------------

    def on_hand(self, warehouse: str, sku: str) -> int:
        """Физический остаток SKU на складе."""
        self._require_sku(sku)
        return self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku)

    def reserved(self, warehouse: str, sku: str) -> int:
        """Сумма действующих резервов по позиции."""
        _validate_code(warehouse, "warehouse")
        self._require_sku(sku)
        return self._reserved_at(self._clock.now(), warehouse, sku)

    def available(self, warehouse: str, sku: str) -> int:
        """Сколько можно зарезервировать или отгрузить свободно: остаток минус резервы, не ниже 0."""
        _validate_code(warehouse, "warehouse")
        self._require_sku(sku)
        return self._available_at(self._clock.now(), warehouse, sku)

    def get_reservation(self, order_id: str) -> Reservation:
        """Снимок резерва на текущий момент."""
        return self._view(self._require_reservation(order_id))

    def stock_levels(self, warehouse: str | None = None) -> list[StockLevel]:
        """Ненулевые физические остатки, отсортированные по складу и SKU."""
        return [
            StockLevel(warehouse=wh, sku=sku, on_hand=qty)
            for wh, sku, qty in self._store.positions()
            if warehouse is None or wh == warehouse
        ]

    def reservations(self, status: ReservationStatus | None = None) -> list[Reservation]:
        """Снимки текущих резервов (по одному на заказ) по ``created_at``, затем по ``order_id``.

        С ``status`` — только резервы с этим статусом на текущий момент.
        """
        now = self._clock.now()
        snapshots = [
            replace(reservation, status=effective_status(reservation, now))
            for reservation in self._reservations.values()
        ]
        if status is not None:
            snapshots = [snapshot for snapshot in snapshots if snapshot.status is status]
        return sorted(snapshots, key=lambda snapshot: (snapshot.created_at, snapshot.order_id))

    def availability(self, warehouse: str | None = None) -> list[Availability]:
        """Строка на каждую позицию с физическим остатком или активным резервом.

        Порядок и фильтр по складу — как у :meth:`stock_levels`.
        """
        now = self._clock.now()
        positions = {(wh, sku) for wh, sku, _ in self._store.positions()}
        positions.update(
            (line.warehouse, line.sku)
            for reservation in self._reservations.values()
            if effective_status(reservation, now) is ReservationStatus.ACTIVE
            for line in reservation.lines
        )
        return [
            Availability(
                warehouse=wh,
                sku=sku,
                on_hand=self._store.get_qty(wh, sku),
                reserved=self._reserved_at(now, wh, sku),
                available=self._available_at(now, wh, sku),
            )
            for wh, sku in sorted(positions)
            if warehouse is None or wh == warehouse
        ]

    # --- операции -----------------------------------------------------------

    def receive(self, warehouse: str, sku: str, qty: int, ref: str | None = None) -> int:
        """Приход товара. Возвращает новый физический остаток."""
        self._check_position(warehouse, sku)
        _validate_qty(qty)
        _validate_ref(ref)
        new_qty = self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku) + qty
        self._store.set_qty(warehouse, sku, new_qty)
        self._log.append(self._clock.now(), "RECEIVE", wh=warehouse, sku=sku, qty=qty, ref=ref)
        logger.info("received %s x%d at %s", sku, qty, warehouse)
        return new_qty

    def issue(self, warehouse: str, sku: str, qty: int, ref: str | None = None) -> int:
        """Расход (отгрузка, списание). Возвращает новый физический остаток.

        Нельзя забрать товар из чужих действующих резервов: проверяется ``available``.
        """
        self._check_position(warehouse, sku)
        _validate_qty(qty)
        _validate_ref(ref)
        current = self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku)
        available = self._available_at(self._clock.now(), warehouse, sku)
        if qty > available:
            raise InsufficientStockError(warehouse, sku, qty, available)
        self._store.set_qty(warehouse, sku, current - qty)
        self._log.append(self._clock.now(), "ISSUE", wh=warehouse, sku=sku, qty=qty, ref=ref)
        logger.info("issued %s x%d from %s", sku, qty, warehouse)
        return current - qty

    def transfer(
        self, source: str, target: str, sku: str, qty: int, ref: str | None = None
    ) -> None:
        """Перемещение между складами одним событием ``TRANSFER``.

        Для склада-источника это обычный расход: проверки те же, что у :meth:`issue`.
        """
        self._check_position(source, sku)
        _validate_code(target, "warehouse")
        if source == target:
            raise ValidationError("source and target warehouses must differ")
        _validate_qty(qty)
        _validate_ref(ref)
        current = self._store.get_qty(source, sku)
        available = self._available_at(self._clock.now(), source, sku)
        if qty > available:
            raise InsufficientStockError(source, sku, qty, available)
        self._store.set_qty(source, sku, current - qty)
        self._store.set_qty(target, sku, self._store.get_qty(target, sku) + qty)
        self._log.append(
            self._clock.now(), "TRANSFER", src=source, dst=target, sku=sku, qty=qty, ref=ref
        )
        logger.info("moved %s x%d %s -> %s", sku, qty, source, target)

    def adjust(self, warehouse: str, sku: str, counted: int, reason: str) -> int:
        """Инвентаризация: фиксирует фактически посчитанный остаток.

        Это факт, а не запрос, поэтому никаких проверок достаточности нет.
        В журнал пишется разница ``delta`` (может быть отрицательной).
        """
        self._check_position(warehouse, sku)
        if isinstance(counted, bool) or not isinstance(counted, int) or counted < 0:
            raise ValidationError(f"counted quantity must be a non-negative integer, got {counted!r}")
        _validate_code(reason, "reason")
        current = self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku)
        self._store.set_qty(warehouse, sku, counted)
        self._log.append(
            self._clock.now(), "ADJUST", wh=warehouse, sku=sku, delta=counted - current, reason=reason
        )
        logger.warning("stock of %s at %s adjusted %d -> %d", sku, warehouse, current, counted)
        return counted

    # --- резервы ------------------------------------------------------------

    def reserve(
        self,
        order_id: str,
        lines: Iterable[tuple[str, str, int] | ReservationLine],
        ttl: timedelta | None = None,
    ) -> Reservation:
        """Резерв товара под заказ по всем строкам сразу. Физический остаток не меняется.

        Повторный резерв по заказу с активным резервом — замена: старый резерв отменяется
        (``RESERVE_CANCEL``), новый создаётся целиком, как при первом резерве, со своим
        ``created_at`` и сроком. Товар заменяемого резерва при проверке наличия свободен.
        Подтверждённый заказ заменить нельзя; истёкший или отменённый резерв просто заменяется.
        """
        _validate_code(order_id, "order id")
        ttl = DEFAULT_RESERVATION_TTL if ttl is None else ttl
        _validate_ttl(ttl)
        if ttl > MAX_RESERVATION_LIFETIME:
            raise ValidationError(
                f"ttl must not exceed {MAX_RESERVATION_LIFETIME}, got {ttl!r}"
            )
        items = _normalize_lines(lines)
        for line in items:
            _validate_code(line.sku, "SKU code")
            self._check_position(line.warehouse, line.sku)
            _validate_qty(line.qty)

        now = self._clock.now()
        existing = self._reservations.get(order_id)
        existing_status = None if existing is None else effective_status(existing, now)
        if existing_status is ReservationStatus.CONFIRMED:
            raise DuplicateReservationError(order_id, existing_status.value)

        for (warehouse, sku), qty in _sum_by_position(items).items():
            available = self._available_at(now, warehouse, sku, exclude_order=order_id)
            if qty > available:
                raise InsufficientStockError(warehouse, sku, qty, available)

        if existing_status is ReservationStatus.ACTIVE:
            self._log.append(now, "RESERVE_CANCEL", order=order_id)
        elif existing_status is ReservationStatus.EXPIRED and not self._is_expiry_reported(existing):
            self._replaced_expired.append(existing)

        expires_at = now + ttl
        reservation = Reservation(
            order_id=order_id,
            lines=items,
            created_at=now,
            expires_at=expires_at,
            status=ReservationStatus.ACTIVE,
        )
        for line in items:
            self._log.append(
                now,
                "RESERVE",
                order=order_id,
                wh=line.warehouse,
                sku=line.sku,
                qty=line.qty,
                expires=format_timestamp(expires_at),
            )
        self._reservations[order_id] = reservation
        logger.info("reserved %d line(s) for order %s", len(items), order_id)
        return self._view(reservation)

    def confirm(self, order_id: str) -> Reservation:
        """Превращает активный резерв в отгрузку: физический остаток уменьшается по строкам."""
        reservation = self._require_reservation(order_id)
        now = self._clock.now()
        status = effective_status(reservation, now)
        if status is ReservationStatus.EXPIRED:
            raise ReservationExpiredError(order_id)
        if status is not ReservationStatus.ACTIVE:
            raise ReservationStateError(order_id, status.value)

        # резерв держит товар под этот заказ, поэтому проверяем только физический остаток
        for (warehouse, sku), qty in _sum_by_position(reservation.lines).items():
            on_hand = self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku)
            if qty > on_hand:
                raise InsufficientStockError(warehouse, sku, qty, on_hand)

        for line in reservation.lines:
            current = self._store.get_qty(line.warehouse, line.sku)
            self._store.set_qty(line.warehouse, line.sku, current - line.qty)
            self._log.append(
                now, "ISSUE", wh=line.warehouse, sku=line.sku, qty=line.qty, ref=order_id
            )
        self._log.append(now, "RESERVE_CONFIRM", order=order_id)
        confirmed = replace(reservation, status=ReservationStatus.CONFIRMED)
        self._reservations[order_id] = confirmed
        logger.info("confirmed reservation %s", order_id)
        return self._view(confirmed)

    def cancel(self, order_id: str) -> Reservation:
        """Отмена резерва. Повторная отмена и отмена истёкшего — no-op.

        Отмена активного резерва освобождает товар. Отмена подтверждённого заказа — возврат:
        товар по каждой строке возвращается на свой склад (``RECEIVE`` с ``ref`` = заказ),
        затем пишется ``RESERVE_CANCEL``.
        """
        reservation = self._require_reservation(order_id)
        now = self._clock.now()
        status = effective_status(reservation, now)
        if status is ReservationStatus.CONFIRMED:
            for line in reservation.lines:
                new_qty = self._store.get_qty(line.warehouse, line.sku) + line.qty
                self._store.set_qty(line.warehouse, line.sku, new_qty)
                self._log.append(
                    now, "RECEIVE", wh=line.warehouse, sku=line.sku, qty=line.qty, ref=order_id
                )
        if status in (ReservationStatus.ACTIVE, ReservationStatus.CONFIRMED):
            self._log.append(now, "RESERVE_CANCEL", order=order_id)
            reservation = replace(reservation, status=ReservationStatus.CANCELLED)
            self._reservations[order_id] = reservation
            logger.info("cancelled reservation %s", order_id)
        return self._view(reservation)

    def extend(self, order_id: str, ttl: timedelta) -> Reservation:
        """Продлевает активный резерв: новый срок ``now + ttl``, но не позже предела
        ``created_at + MAX_RESERVATION_LIFETIME`` и никогда не раньше текущего срока."""
        _validate_ttl(ttl)
        reservation = self._require_reservation(order_id)
        now = self._clock.now()
        status = effective_status(reservation, now)
        if status is ReservationStatus.EXPIRED:
            raise ReservationExpiredError(order_id)
        if status is not ReservationStatus.ACTIVE:
            raise ReservationStateError(order_id, status.value)

        new_expires_at = min(
            now + ttl, reservation.created_at + MAX_RESERVATION_LIFETIME
        )
        if new_expires_at <= reservation.expires_at:
            return self._view(reservation)
        reservation = replace(reservation, expires_at=new_expires_at)
        self._reservations[order_id] = reservation
        self._log.append(
            now, "RESERVE_EXTEND", order=order_id, expires=format_timestamp(new_expires_at)
        )
        logger.info("extended reservation %s", order_id)
        return reservation

    def sweep_expired(self) -> list[str]:
        """Пишет ``RESERVE_EXPIRE`` по истёкшим резервам, о которых ещё не писали.

        Каждый резерв — один раз; новый резерв того же заказа — отдельный и тоже попадает.
        Статусы и остатки не меняются. Возвращает ``order_id`` в порядке ``expires_at``,
        затем ``order_id``.
        """
        now = self._clock.now()
        expired = [
            reservation
            for reservation in [*self._reservations.values(), *self._replaced_expired]
            if effective_status(reservation, now) is ReservationStatus.EXPIRED
        ]
        expired.sort(key=lambda reservation: (reservation.expires_at, reservation.order_id))
        order_ids: list[str] = []
        for reservation in expired:
            if self._is_expiry_reported(reservation):
                continue
            self._log.append(
                now,
                "RESERVE_EXPIRE",
                order=reservation.order_id,
                expires=format_timestamp(reservation.expires_at),
            )
            self._expiry_reported.add(_expiry_key(reservation))
            order_ids.append(reservation.order_id)
            logger.info("reservation %s expired", reservation.order_id)
        self._replaced_expired = [
            reservation
            for reservation in self._replaced_expired
            if not self._is_expiry_reported(reservation)
        ]
        return order_ids

    # --- служебное ----------------------------------------------------------

    def _is_expiry_reported(self, reservation: Reservation) -> bool:
        return _expiry_key(reservation) in self._expiry_reported

    def _require_sku(self, sku: str) -> None:
        if not self._store.has_sku(sku):
            raise UnknownSkuError(sku)

    def _check_position(self, warehouse: str, sku: str) -> None:
        _validate_code(warehouse, "warehouse")
        self._require_sku(sku)

    def _require_reservation(self, order_id: str) -> Reservation:
        _validate_code(order_id, "order id")
        reservation = self._reservations.get(order_id)
        if reservation is None:
            raise ReservationNotFoundError(order_id)
        return reservation

    def _view(self, reservation: Reservation) -> Reservation:
        """Снимок резерва со статусом на текущий момент."""
        status = effective_status(reservation, self._clock.now())
        return replace(reservation, status=status)

    def _reserved_at(self, now: datetime, warehouse: str, sku: str) -> int:
        total = 0
        for reservation in self._reservations.values():
            if effective_status(reservation, now) is not ReservationStatus.ACTIVE:
                continue
            for line in reservation.lines:
                if line.warehouse == warehouse and line.sku == sku:
                    total += line.qty
        return total

    def _available_at(self, now: datetime, warehouse: str, sku: str) -> int:
        # инвентаризация может опустить остаток ниже резервов — тогда свободно 0, а не минус
        on_hand = self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku)
        return max(0, on_hand - self._reserved_at(now, warehouse, sku))


def _validate_code(value: object, what: str) -> None:
    """Коды складов/SKU/ссылок попадают в журнал, поэтому без пробелов."""
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value or any(ch.isspace() for ch in value) or "=" in value:
        raise ValidationError(f"{what} must be a non-empty string without spaces, got {value!r}")


def _validate_ref(ref: object) -> None:
    if ref is not None:
        _validate_code(ref, "ref")


def _validate_qty(qty: object) -> None:
    if isinstance(qty, bool) or not isinstance(qty, int) or qty <= 0:
        raise InvalidQuantityError(qty)


def _validate_ttl(ttl: object) -> None:
    if not isinstance(ttl, timedelta) or ttl <= timedelta(0):
        raise ValidationError(f"ttl must be a positive timedelta, got {ttl!r}")


def _normalize_lines(
    lines: Iterable[tuple[str, str, int] | ReservationLine],
) -> tuple[ReservationLine, ...]:
    """Строки резерва в исходном порядке; пустой резерв — ошибка."""
    items: list[ReservationLine] = []
    for item in lines:
        if isinstance(item, ReservationLine):
            items.append(item)
        elif isinstance(item, tuple) and len(item) == 3:
            items.append(ReservationLine(*item))
        else:
            raise ValidationError(f"reservation line must be (warehouse, sku, qty), got {item!r}")
    if not items:

    return totals

"""Сервис складского учёта: приход, расход, перемещение, инвентаризация.

Любая операция, меняющая остатки, пишет событие в журнал
(:class:`~warehouse.events.EventLog`). Операция либо выполняется целиком,
либо не меняет ничего — ни остатков, ни журнала.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from dataclasses import replace
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Iterable

from .clock import Clock, SystemClock
from .errors import (
    DuplicateReservationError,
    DuplicateSkuError,
    InsufficientStockError,
    InvalidQuantityError,
    ReservationExpiredError,
    ReservationNotFoundError,
    ReservationStateError,
    UnknownSkuError,
    ValidationError,
)
from .events import EventLog, format_timestamp
from .models import Availability, Reservation, ReservationLine, ReservationStatus, Sku, StockLevel
from .reservations import DEFAULT_RESERVATION_TTL, MAX_RESERVATION_LIFETIME, effective_status
from .storage import InMemoryStore

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class Inventory:
    """Остатки товаров по складам и резервы под заказы."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        store: InMemoryStore | None = None,
        clock: Clock | None = None,
        log: EventLog | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._store = store if store is not None else InMemoryStore()
        self._clock = clock if clock is not None else SystemClock()
        self._log = log if log is not None else EventLog()
        # хранятся статусы ACTIVE / CONFIRMED / CANCELLED; EXPIRED вычисляется по часам
        self._reservations: dict[str, Reservation] = {}
        # истёкшие резервы, которые заменил новый до того, как о них записали RESERVE_EXPIRE
        self._replaced_expired: list[Reservation] = []
        # о каких истёкших резервах уже записано RESERVE_EXPIRE: (order_id, created_at)
        self._expiry_reported: set[tuple[str, datetime]] = set()

    @property
    def store(self) -> InMemoryStore:
        return self._store

    @property
    def clock(self) -> Clock:
        return self._clock

    @property
    def log(self) -> EventLog:
        return self._log

    # --- справочник ---------------------------------------------------------

    def register_sku(self, code: str, name: str, unit: str = "pcs") -> Sku:
        _validate_code(code, "SKU code")
        if self._store.has_sku(code):
            raise DuplicateSkuError(code)
        sku = Sku(code=code, name=name, unit=unit)
        self._store.add_sku(sku)
        logger.info("registered SKU %s", code)
        return sku

    def get_sku(self, code: str) -> Sku:
        sku = self._store.get_sku(code)
        if sku is None:
            raise UnknownSkuError(code)
        return sku

    # --- запросы ------------------------------------------------------------

    def on_hand(self, warehouse: str, sku: str) -> int:
        """Физический остаток SKU на складе."""
        self._require_sku(sku)
        return self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku)

    def reserved(self, warehouse: str, sku: str) -> int:
        """Сумма действующих резервов по позиции."""
        _validate_code(warehouse, "warehouse")
        self._require_sku(sku)
        return self._reserved_at(self._clock.now(), warehouse, sku)

    def available(self, warehouse: str, sku: str) -> int:
        """Сколько можно зарезервировать или отгрузить свободно: остаток минус резервы, не ниже 0."""
        _validate_code(warehouse, "warehouse")
        self._require_sku(sku)
        return self._available_at(self._clock.now(), warehouse, sku)

    def get_reservation(self, order_id: str) -> Reservation:
        """Снимок резерва на текущий момент."""
        return self._view(self._require_reservation(order_id))

    def stock_levels(self, warehouse: str | None = None) -> list[StockLevel]:
        """Ненулевые физические остатки, отсортированные по складу и SKU."""
        return [
            StockLevel(warehouse=wh, sku=sku, on_hand=qty)
            for wh, sku, qty in self._store.positions()
            if warehouse is None or wh == warehouse
        ]

    def reservations(self, status: ReservationStatus | None = None) -> list[Reservation]:
        """Снимки текущих резервов (по одному на заказ) по ``created_at``, затем по ``order_id``.

        С ``status`` — только резервы с этим статусом на текущий момент.
        """
        now = self._clock.now()
        snapshots = [
            replace(reservation, status=effective_status(reservation, now))
            for reservation in self._reservations.values()
        ]
        if status is not None:
            snapshots = [snapshot for snapshot in snapshots if snapshot.status is status]
        return sorted(snapshots, key=lambda snapshot: (snapshot.created_at, snapshot.order_id))

    def availability(self, warehouse: str | None = None) -> list[Availability]:
        """Строка на каждую позицию с физическим остатком или активным резервом.

        Порядок и фильтр по складу — как у :meth:`stock_levels`.
        """
        now = self._clock.now()
        positions = {(wh, sku) for wh, sku, _ in self._store.positions()}
        positions.update(
            (line.warehouse, line.sku)
            for reservation in self._reservations.values()
            if effective_status(reservation, now) is ReservationStatus.ACTIVE
            for line in reservation.lines
        )
        return [
            Availability(
                warehouse=wh,
                sku=sku,
                on_hand=self._store.get_qty(wh, sku),
                reserved=self._reserved_at(now, wh, sku),
                available=self._available_at(now, wh, sku),
            )
            for wh, sku in sorted(positions)
            if warehouse is None or wh == warehouse
        ]

    # --- операции -----------------------------------------------------------

    def receive(self, warehouse: str, sku: str, qty: int, ref: str | None = None) -> int:
        """Приход товара. Возвращает новый физический остаток."""
        self._check_position(warehouse, sku)
        _validate_qty(qty)
        _validate_ref(ref)
        new_qty = self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku) + qty
        self._store.set_qty(warehouse, sku, new_qty)
        self._log.append(self._clock.now(), "RECEIVE", wh=warehouse, sku=sku, qty=qty, ref=ref)
        logger.info("received %s x%d at %s", sku, qty, warehouse)
        return new_qty

    def issue(self, warehouse: str, sku: str, qty: int, ref: str | None = None) -> int:
        """Расход (отгрузка, списание). Возвращает новый физический остаток.

        Нельзя забрать товар из чужих действующих резервов: проверяется ``available``.
        """
        self._check_position(warehouse, sku)
        _validate_qty(qty)
        _validate_ref(ref)
        current = self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku)
        available = self._available_at(self._clock.now(), warehouse, sku)
        if qty > available:
            raise InsufficientStockError(warehouse, sku, qty, available)
        self._store.set_qty(warehouse, sku, current - qty)
        self._log.append(self._clock.now(), "ISSUE", wh=warehouse, sku=sku, qty=qty, ref=ref)
        logger.info("issued %s x%d from %s", sku, qty, warehouse)
        return current - qty

    def transfer(
        self, source: str, target: str, sku: str, qty: int, ref: str | None = None
    ) -> None:
        """Перемещение между складами одним событием ``TRANSFER``.

        Для склада-источника это обычный расход: проверки те же, что у :meth:`issue`.
        """
        self._check_position(source, sku)
        _validate_code(target, "warehouse")
        if source == target:
            raise ValidationError("source and target warehouses must differ")
        _validate_qty(qty)
        _validate_ref(ref)
        current = self._store.get_qty(source, sku)
        available = self._available_at(self._clock.now(), source, sku)
        if qty > available:
            raise InsufficientStockError(source, sku, qty, available)
        self._store.set_qty(source, sku, current - qty)
        self._store.set_qty(target, sku, self._store.get_qty(target, sku) + qty)
        self._log.append(
            self._clock.now(), "TRANSFER", src=source, dst=target, sku=sku, qty=qty, ref=ref
        )
        logger.info("moved %s x%d %s -> %s", sku, qty, source, target)

    def adjust(self, warehouse: str, sku: str, counted: int, reason: str) -> int:
        """Инвентаризация: фиксирует фактически посчитанный остаток.

        Это факт, а не запрос, поэтому никаких проверок достаточности нет.
        В журнал пишется разница ``delta`` (может быть отрицательной).
        """
        self._check_position(warehouse, sku)
        if isinstance(counted, bool) or not isinstance(counted, int) or counted < 0:
            raise ValidationError(f"counted quantity must be a non-negative integer, got {counted!r}")
        _validate_code(reason, "reason")
        current = self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku)
        self._store.set_qty(warehouse, sku, counted)
        self._log.append(
            self._clock.now(), "ADJUST", wh=warehouse, sku=sku, delta=counted - current, reason=reason
        )
        logger.warning("stock of %s at %s adjusted %d -> %d", sku, warehouse, current, counted)
        return counted

    # --- резервы ------------------------------------------------------------

    def reserve(
        self,
        order_id: str,
        lines: Iterable[tuple[str, str, int] | ReservationLine],
        ttl: timedelta | None = None,
    ) -> Reservation:
        """Резерв товара под заказ по всем строкам сразу. Физический остаток не меняется.

        Повторный резерв по заказу с активным резервом — замена: старый резерв отменяется
        (``RESERVE_CANCEL``), новый создаётся целиком, как при первом резерве, со своим
        ``created_at`` и сроком. Товар заменяемого резерва при проверке наличия свободен.
        Подтверждённый заказ заменить нельзя; истёкший или отменённый резерв просто заменяется.
        """
        _validate_code(order_id, "order id")
        ttl = DEFAULT_RESERVATION_TTL if ttl is None else ttl
        _validate_ttl(ttl)
        if ttl > MAX_RESERVATION_LIFETIME:
            raise ValidationError(
                f"ttl must not exceed {MAX_RESERVATION_LIFETIME}, got {ttl!r}"
            )
        items = _normalize_lines(lines)
        for line in items:
            _validate_code(line.sku, "SKU code")
            self._check_position(line.warehouse, line.sku)
            _validate_qty(line.qty)

        now = self._clock.now()
        existing = self._reservations.get(order_id)
        existing_status = None if existing is None else effective_status(existing, now)
        if existing_status is ReservationStatus.CONFIRMED:
            raise DuplicateReservationError(order_id, existing_status.value)

        for (warehouse, sku), qty in _sum_by_position(items).items():
            available = self._available_at(now, warehouse, sku, exclude_order=order_id)
            if qty > available:
                raise InsufficientStockError(warehouse, sku, qty, available)

        if existing_status is ReservationStatus.ACTIVE:
            self._log.append(now, "RESERVE_CANCEL", order=order_id)
        elif existing_status is ReservationStatus.EXPIRED and not self._is_expiry_reported(existing):
            self._replaced_expired.append(existing)

        expires_at = now + ttl
        reservation = Reservation(
            order_id=order_id,
            lines=items,
            created_at=now,
            expires_at=expires_at,
            status=ReservationStatus.ACTIVE,
        )
        for line in items:
            self._log.append(
                now,
                "RESERVE",
                order=order_id,
                wh=line.warehouse,
                sku=line.sku,
                qty=line.qty,
                expires=format_timestamp(expires_at),
            )
        self._reservations[order_id] = reservation
        logger.info("reserved %d line(s) for order %s", len(items), order_id)
        return self._view(reservation)

    def confirm(self, order_id: str) -> Reservation:
        """Превращает активный резерв в отгрузку: физический остаток уменьшается по строкам."""
        reservation = self._require_reservation(order_id)
        now = self._clock.now()
        status = effective_status(reservation, now)
        if status is ReservationStatus.EXPIRED:
            raise ReservationExpiredError(order_id)
        if status is not ReservationStatus.ACTIVE:
            raise ReservationStateError(order_id, status.value)

        # резерв держит товар под этот заказ, поэтому проверяем только физический остаток
        for (warehouse, sku), qty in _sum_by_position(reservation.lines).items():
            on_hand = self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku)
            if qty > on_hand:
                raise InsufficientStockError(warehouse, sku, qty, on_hand)

        for line in reservation.lines:
            current = self._store.get_qty(line.warehouse, line.sku)
            self._store.set_qty(line.warehouse, line.sku, current - line.qty)
            self._log.append(
                now, "ISSUE", wh=line.warehouse, sku=line.sku, qty=line.qty, ref=order_id
            )
        self._log.append(now, "RESERVE_CONFIRM", order=order_id)
        confirmed = replace(reservation, status=ReservationStatus.CONFIRMED)
        self._reservations[order_id] = confirmed
        logger.info("confirmed reservation %s", order_id)
        return self._view(confirmed)

    def cancel(self, order_id: str) -> Reservation:
        """Отмена резерва. Повторная отмена и отмена истёкшего — no-op.

        Отмена активного резерва освобождает товар. Отмена подтверждённого заказа — возврат:
        товар по каждой строке возвращается на свой склад (``RECEIVE`` с ``ref`` = заказ),
        затем пишется ``RESERVE_CANCEL``.
        """
        reservation = self._require_reservation(order_id)
        now = self._clock.now()
        status = effective_status(reservation, now)
        if status is ReservationStatus.CONFIRMED:
            for line in reservation.lines:
                new_qty = self._store.get_qty(line.warehouse, line.sku) + line.qty
                self._store.set_qty(line.warehouse, line.sku, new_qty)
                self._log.append(
                    now, "RECEIVE", wh=line.warehouse, sku=line.sku, qty=line.qty, ref=order_id
                )
        if status in (ReservationStatus.ACTIVE, ReservationStatus.CONFIRMED):
            self._log.append(now, "RESERVE_CANCEL", order=order_id)
            reservation = replace(reservation, status=ReservationStatus.CANCELLED)
            self._reservations[order_id] = reservation
            logger.info("cancelled reservation %s", order_id)
        return self._view(reservation)

    def extend(self, order_id: str, ttl: timedelta) -> Reservation:
        """Продлевает активный резерв: новый срок ``now + ttl``, но не позже предела
        ``created_at + MAX_RESERVATION_LIFETIME`` и никогда не раньше текущего срока."""
        _validate_ttl(ttl)
        reservation = self._require_reservation(order_id)
        now = self._clock.now()
        status = effective_status(reservation, now)
        if status is ReservationStatus.EXPIRED:
            raise ReservationExpiredError(order_id)
        if status is not ReservationStatus.ACTIVE:
            raise ReservationStateError(order_id, status.value)

        new_expires_at = min(
            now + ttl, reservation.created_at + MAX_RESERVATION_LIFETIME
        )
        if new_expires_at <= reservation.expires_at:
            return self._view(reservation)
        reservation = replace(reservation, expires_at=new_expires_at)
        self._reservations[order_id] = reservation
        self._log.append(
            now, "RESERVE_EXTEND", order=order_id, expires=format_timestamp(new_expires_at)
        )
        logger.info("extended reservation %s", order_id)
        return reservation

    def sweep_expired(self) -> list[str]:
        """Пишет ``RESERVE_EXPIRE`` по истёкшим резервам, о которых ещё не писали.

        Каждый резерв — один раз; новый резерв того же заказа — отдельный и тоже попадает.
        Статусы и остатки не меняются. Возвращает ``order_id`` в порядке ``expires_at``,
        затем ``order_id``.
        """
        now = self._clock.now()
        expired = [
            reservation
            for reservation in [*self._reservations.values(), *self._replaced_expired]
            if effective_status(reservation, now) is ReservationStatus.EXPIRED
        ]
        expired.sort(key=lambda reservation: (reservation.expires_at, reservation.order_id))
        order_ids: list[str] = []
        for reservation in expired:
            if self._is_expiry_reported(reservation):
                continue
            self._log.append(
                now,
                "RESERVE_EXPIRE",
                order=reservation.order_id,
                expires=format_timestamp(reservation.expires_at),
            )
            self._expiry_reported.add(_expiry_key(reservation))
            order_ids.append(reservation.order_id)
            logger.info("reservation %s expired", reservation.order_id)
        self._replaced_expired = [
            reservation
            for reservation in self._replaced_expired
            if not self._is_expiry_reported(reservation)
        ]
        return order_ids

    # --- служебное ----------------------------------------------------------

    def _is_expiry_reported(self, reservation: Reservation) -> bool:
        return _expiry_key(reservation) in self._expiry_reported

    def _require_sku(self, sku: str) -> None:
        if not self._store.has_sku(sku):
            raise UnknownSkuError(sku)

    def _check_position(self, warehouse: str, sku: str) -> None:
        _validate_code(warehouse, "warehouse")
        self._require_sku(sku)

    def _require_reservation(self, order_id: str) -> Reservation:
        _validate_code(order_id, "order id")
        reservation = self._reservations.get(order_id)
        if reservation is None:
            raise ReservationNotFoundError(order_id)
        return reservation

    def _view(self, reservation: Reservation) -> Reservation:
        """Снимок резерва со статусом на текущий момент."""
        status = effective_status(reservation, self._clock.now())
        return replace(reservation, status=status)

    def _reserved_at(
        self, now: datetime, warehouse: str, sku: str, exclude_order: str | None = None
    ) -> int:
        total = 0
        for reservation in self._reservations.values():
            if reservation.order_id == exclude_order:
                continue
            if effective_status(reservation, now) is not ReservationStatus.ACTIVE:
                continue
            for line in reservation.lines:
                if line.warehouse == warehouse and line.sku == sku:
                    total += line.qty
        return total

    def _available_at(
        self, now: datetime, warehouse: str, sku: str, exclude_order: str | None = None
    ) -> int:
        # инвентаризация может опустить остаток ниже резервов — тогда свободно 0, а не минус
        on_hand = self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku)
        return max(0, on_hand - self._reserved_at(now, warehouse, sku, exclude_order))


def _validate_code(value: object, what: str) -> None:
    """Коды складов/SKU/ссылок попадают в журнал, поэтому без пробелов."""
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value or any(ch.isspace() for ch in value) or "=" in value:
        raise ValidationError(f"{what} must be a non-empty string without spaces, got {value!r}")


def _validate_ref(ref: object) -> None:
    if ref is not None:
        _validate_code(ref, "ref")


def _validate_qty(qty: object) -> None:
    if isinstance(qty, bool) or not isinstance(qty, int) or qty <= 0:
        raise InvalidQuantityError(qty)


def _validate_ttl(ttl: object) -> None:
    if not isinstance(ttl, timedelta) or ttl <= timedelta(0):
        raise ValidationError(f"ttl must be a positive timedelta, got {ttl!r}")


def _normalize_lines(
    lines: Iterable[tuple[str, str, int] | ReservationLine],
) -> tuple[ReservationLine, ...]:
    """Строки резерва в исходном порядке; пустой резерв — ошибка."""
    items: list[ReservationLine] = []
    for item in lines:
        if isinstance(item, ReservationLine):
            items.append(item)
        elif isinstance(item, tuple) and len(item) == 3:
            items.append(ReservationLine(*item))
        else:
            raise ValidationError(f"reservation line must be (warehouse, sku, qty), got {item!r}")
    if not items:
        raise ValidationError("reservation must have at least one line")
    return tuple(items)


def _sum_by_position(lines: Iterable[ReservationLine]) -> dict[tuple[str, str], int]:
    """Суммы по позициям (склад, SKU) в порядке первого появления."""
    totals: dict[tuple[str, str], int] = {}
    for line in lines:
        key = (line.warehouse, line.sku)
        totals[key] = totals.get(key, 0) + line.qty
    return totals

from .test_reservations import T0, kinds


def test_default_ttl_is_twenty_minutes():
    assert DEFAULT_RESERVATION_TTL == timedelta(minutes=20)


def test_max_lifetime_is_two_hours():
    assert MAX_RESERVATION_LIFETIME == timedelta(hours=2)


def test_reserve_rejects_ttl_above_limit(inv):
    inv.receive("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 1)], ttl=MAX_RESERVATION_LIFETIME + timedelta(seconds=1))
    assert len(inv.log) == 1


def test_reserve_accepts_ttl_at_limit(inv):
    inv.receive("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)
    res = inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 1)], ttl=MAX_RESERVATION_LIFETIME)
    assert res.expires_at == T0 + MAX_RESERVATION_LIFETIME


def test_extend_beyond_limit_clamps_to_limit(inv, clock):
    inv.receive("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)
    inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 1)], ttl=timedelta(minutes=30))
    clock.advance(timedelta(minutes=90))
    res = inv.extend("SO-1", timedelta(hours=5))
    assert res.expires_at == T0 + MAX_RESERVATION_LIFETIME
    assert inv.log.events("RESERVE_EXTEND")[0].get("expires") == "2026-03-01T12:00:00Z"


def test_extend_at_limit_is_noop(inv, clock):
    inv.receive("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)
    inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 1)], ttl=MAX_RESERVATION_LIFETIME)
    clock.advance(timedelta(minutes=10))
    res = inv.extend("SO-1", timedelta(hours=5))
    assert res.expires_at == T0 + MAX_RESERVATION_LIFETIME
    assert inv.log.events("RESERVE_EXTEND") == []


def test_replace_active_reservation_frees_its_own_stock(inv):
    inv.receive("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)
    inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)])
    res = inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 4)])
    assert res.status is ReservationStatus.ACTIVE
    assert res.lines == (ReservationLine("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 4),)
    assert inv.reserved("MAIN", "BOLT-M8") == 4
    assert inv.available("MAIN", "BOLT-M8") == 1


def test_replace_writes_cancel_then_new_reserve_lines(inv, clock):
    inv.receive("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)
    inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 1)])
    clock.advance(timedelta(minutes=5))
    inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 2), ("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 1)])
    assert kinds(inv) == ["RECEIVE", "RESERVE", "RESERVE_CANCEL", "RESERVE", "RESERVE"]
    new_lines = inv.log.events("RESERVE")[1:]
    assert all(e.get("expires") == "2026-03-01T10:25:00Z" for e in new_lines)


def test_replace_gets_new_created_at_and_full_ttl(inv, clock):
    inv.receive("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)
    inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 1)])
    clock.advance(timedelta(minutes=5))
    res = inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 1)], ttl=timedelta(minutes=60))
    assert res.created_at == T0 + timedelta(minutes=5)
    assert res.expires_at == T0 + timedelta(minutes=65)

    inv.receive("MAIN", "NUT-M8", 1)

    with pytest.raises(InsufficientStockError) as info:

    assert (info.value.sku, info.value.requested, info.value.available) == ("NUT-M8", 2, 1)
    assert inv.get_reservation("SO-1").lines == (ReservationLine("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5),)

    tail = inv.log.lines()[-3:]

    receives = inv.log.events("RECEIVE")[-2:]
    assert [(e.get("wh"), e.get("sku"), e.get("qty"), e.get("ref")) for e in receives] == [
        ("NORTH", "NUT-M8", "2", "SO-1"),
        ("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", "3", "SO-1"),
